title: ionopsidium glastifolium
intro: Ionopsidium glastifolium, commonly known as Snake's Head or White Snake Root, is a plant species in the family Ranunculaceae. It has been traditionally used for its potential health benefits, which include treating respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its ability to loosen and clear mucus from the lungs. The therapeutic actions of Ionopsidium glastifolium include anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties, which contribute to its use in treating various respiratory conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include glycosides, which have been shown to possess anti-inflammatory and anti-spasmodic properties.
